report_name: ConnectWise Suspends Services After M365 Supply Chain Attack

threat_actors.name: Unidentified Actor
threat_actors.description: An unidentified threat actor who conducted a supply chain attack against ConnectWise by obtaining a highly privileged API secret for the ConnectWise Cloud Backup application. This credential was used to access the Microsoft 365 environments of hundreds of downstream customers.

attack_patterns.name: Trusted Relationship
attack_patterns.description: The attacker abused the trusted relationship and extensive permissions granted to the ConnectWise Cloud Backup multi-tenant application to access customer Microsoft 365 environments.

attack_patterns.name: Valid Accounts: Cloud Accounts
attack_patterns.description: The attacker used a compromised API secret for the 'ConnectWise Cloud Backup' service principal to authenticate and gain unauthorized access to customer M365 tenants.

attack_patterns.name: Steal Application Access Token
attack_patterns.description: The threat actor obtained a highly privileged API secret for the ConnectWise Cloud Backup application, which was used to bypass normal authentication.

attack_patterns.name: Data from Cloud Storage
attack_patterns.description: The attacker accessed and was capable of downloading files from customer SharePoint sites and OneDrive accounts using the compromised application permissions.

attack_patterns.name: Remote Email Collection
attack_patterns.description: The attacker gained the ability to read and exfiltrate emails from any user's mailbox within the compromised Microsoft 365 tenants via the compromised API secret.

identities.name: ConnectWise
identities.description: An IT management software provider whose Cloud Backup service was compromised in a supply chain attack, leading to the suspension of its cloud services.

identities.name: Microsoft
identities.description: Provider of the Microsoft 365 platform, including Exchange Online, Teams, and SharePoint Online, which were the targets of data access by the threat actor.

identities.name: ConnectWise Customers
identities.description: Hundreds of ConnectWise partners and their downstream clients whose Microsoft 365 tenants were accessed by the attacker using the compromised API secret.
